ops.title: gvisor-20251110.0 in current flake.lock fails to build (next redeploy breaks)
ops.description:
Discovered during the apple-container E2 image build (cc-notes log apple-container-prototype, 2026-07-15). The repo's current nixpkgs lock (rev 6201e203, nixos-25.05) ships `gvisor-20251110.0`, which **fails to build**: a Go 1.25/1.26 build-tag clash — `pkg/sync WaitReasonSelect redeclared`. 

Impact: the live hermes currently runs the older, valid `runsc 20250512.0` (built from an earlier lock and not re-switched since the lock advanced). The **next** `nixos-rebuild switch` / `just redeploy hermes` on the current lock will fail at the gVisor derivation, blocking any hermes deploy — and gVisor is the code-exec sandbox runtime (`default-runtime = runsc` in nixos/hermes.nix:627-643), so it's not optional.

Fix options to evaluate: pin gvisor to a working revision (e.g. the 20250512.0 the live host runs) via an overlay, bump nixpkgs to a rev where gvisor-20251110.0's build-tag clash is resolved upstream, or hold the gvisor package back until nixpkgs carries a Go-1.26-compatible gvisor. Verify with a dry `nixos-rebuild build` of #hermes before the next real deploy. NOT touched by the container prototype (that pass is zero-repo-edits); this is a standalone repo hygiene fix.

ops.text: nixos-rebuild build (or just redeploy dry-activate) of the hermes config on the current/updated flake.lock completes the gVisor build without the Go 1.25/1.26 WaitReasonSelect-redeclared failure
The live hermes still runs a working runsc after the fix (no regression of the code-exec sandbox)
